gloss: subparagraph, clause (sentence within a paragraph of a law); verse (of the Bible)

example.en: The amendment changes the second subparagraph of the article.

why: in Greek law εδάφιο is a sentence-level subdivision of a παράγραφος, not a paragraph
figurative obfuscation/cover-up sense dominates today's news; wartime blackout is secondary

plural γράσα unnatural here

gloss: wedding sponsor, best man / maid of honour (formal for κουμπάρος/κουμπάρα)

example.el: Η αδερφή της νύφης ήταν η παράνυμφος στον γάμο.
example.en: The bride's sister was the maid of honour (κουμπάρα) at the wedding.

why: in Greek usage παράνυμφος is the formal term for κουμπάρος/κουμπάρα (wedding sponsor), not a Western bridesmaid
άντρας (man) is not a synonym of the adjective
εξαγριώνομαι (become enraged, of people) not a near-synonym
διευθυντής/μεσολαβητής are not near-synonyms
οπλική θητεία doubtful; στρατιωτικός/πολεμικός are broader, not synonyms
μπαλιά/σουτ are not synonyms of kick
